description: Permanently delete Besidka artifacts with all their versions, their public links and the progress visitors saved in them. Artifacts under a legal hold are not deleted and come back in `held`; ids that are not yours or do not exist come back in `notFound`. Deleted artifacts cannot be restored. Requires signing in (data:delete).

confirm.description: Must be true: deleted artifacts cannot be restored

ids.description: Artifact ids from list_artifacts, up to 20 per call

name: delete_artifacts
title: Delete artifacts
